info.name: Datadog Get the Csm Serverless Coverage Analysis

items.docs:
Get the CSM Coverage Analysis of your Serverless Resources.
This is calculated based on the number of agents running on your Serverless
Resources with CSM feature(s) enabled.

info.name: Datadog Get All Csm Serverless Agents

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to include in a single page.

params.name: query
params.description: A search query string to filter results (for example, `hostname:COMP-T2H4J27423`).

params.name: order_direction
params.description: The sort direction for results. Use `asc` for ascending or `desc` for descending.

items.docs: Get the list of all CSM Serverless Agents running on your hosts and containers.
